name: Shirasagi Utaha
source:
Class: 3-A

The student council president who is also [url=/c130984]Kukuri[/url]'s classmate. She is the daughter of Toogami Private Academy's vice principal. A very polite girl who is always kind to everyone, however, because of her strong sense of justice, she won't tolerate anyone breaking the rules, which has led to some students fearing her. She has excellent grades and is always at the top of her class.

 She also loves cute things.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]
